card.text: Small asteroid with a two-lobed moon, Selam.

introduction.text: Dinkinesh was the first asteroid Lucy flew past. It has an equatorial ridge and a trough.

tempest-shape.title: Dinkinesh model used by TEMPEST
tempest-shape.summary: Numerical shape distributed with the TEMPEST thermal model; unseen terrain is estimated.

shape.title: Lucy encounter reconstruction
shape.summary: A community reconstruction inspired by Lucy images, scaled to the published size; not the mission's shape.
